sentences.text: ( By Shri Arvind Singh - Government Advocate)

This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 144/2023, registered at Police Station-Bamnora, District Chhatarpur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 450 and 34 of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is a woman and she cannot commit rape of another woman.
It is further submitted that only allegation against the applicant is that she had helped accused to flee away with prosecutrix by paying some money.

In these Smt. Geeta Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181790170/
1 circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5 . Considering the role of the applicant, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for her regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.

( VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE vkt Smt. Geeta Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181790170/
